breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains the conflicting instruction. It states 'Use a gamma-centered k-point grid of 12 × 12 × 8 for all calculations' but then contradicts this by specifying 'an automatic Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half-cell shift (0.5 0.5 0.5)' for nscf/bands/DOS steps. The ground truth removes the half-shift instruction entirely, keeping only the gamma-centered grid. The generated spec perpetuates the same inconsistency present in the incomplete prompt.
